These interact in a non-linear fashion where poor physical condition exacerbates the impact of overconfidence, leading to tactical missteps. The degradation index reflects a critical failure mode: late-game collapse due to cumulative stress. The physical condition factor acts as a multiplier on overall capability, while overconfidence introduces variance in decision-making quality. Together, these form a triadic system of failure modes in competitive sports.
